setup.cmd: tar xzf p7.tgz && gunzip -f proj/inputs/texts.jsonl.gz && pip install -q laya && python -c 'import torch; print(torch.cuda.get_device_name(0))'

steps.name: smoke
cmds: python scripts/aaai27/score_texts.py --texts inputs/texts.jsonl --keys inputs/keys_job7.txt --model monitor/run1 --out smoke/run1.jsonl --limit 8
python scripts/aaai27/score_texts.py --texts inputs/texts.jsonl --keys inputs/keys_job7.txt --model base --out smoke/zeroshot.jsonl --limit 8

steps.name: score
cmds: python scripts/aaai27/score_texts.py --texts inputs/texts.jsonl --keys inputs/keys_job7.txt --model monitor/run1 --out scores_run1.jsonl
python scripts/aaai27/score_texts.py --texts inputs/texts.jsonl --keys inputs/keys_job7.txt --model base --out scores_zeroshot.jsonl
